5. [RARC.14.5] **Adapter-disconnect recovery semantics.**
   The engine has no concept of a disconnected
   adapter ([NADP.5.1.1]). Rules do not pause, the
   callback keeps being invoked, and an unreachable
   adapter is reported by the callback returning
   `CallError` with a code it chooses ([RARC.9.5.2]).
   Pending correlations are neither cancelled nor
   replayed by the engine.
